summary.intent: Orchestrate a multi-trail hardening effort on the michi repo via parallel subagents (envelope integrity, NAPI structure, release signing, pipeline redaction, hygiene, pipeline observers), landing each as a draft PR and then sequencing a second group of follow-up work.
summary.outcome: All six first-group trails landed as draft PRs (#117-#122); the stuck `gh pr create` hang was diagnosed (interactive prompt) and worked around. An integrator agent (merging T1, T2, T4 into one base) and a zig-pinning agent were launched, with the second group planned but not started.

repo: `gh pr create` is enforced by a hook for opening PRs; the REST API route (`gh api .../pulls`) is blocked, so it must be used directly.
`just check` rewrites a stale `fuzz/Cargo.lock`, and `pnpm test` rewrites `pnpm-lock.yaml` and `pnpm-workspace.yaml`; agents had to revert these before committing.
moon format task (`just fmt-check`) fails inside the sandbox; the pre-commit hook passes unsandboxed.
michi-graph builds for thumbv7em-none-eabihf in CI but thumbv6m is unsupported because the builder id uses `AtomicUsize::fetch_add`.
NAPI output renders up to 19x the held bytes, so the byte cap was lowered from 64 MiB to 16 MiB to keep worst case under V8's string limit.
napi-derive only resolves field type names for modules already expanded, so `ToonOptions.rows` and `StatusItem.value` need explicit `ts_type`.
`redact_secrets` is not idempotent when a secret matches part of the `[REDACTED]` marker (e.g. `RED`, `[`); documented rather than fixed.
The NAPI decoder (`napi/input.rs`) cannot be fuzzed with cargo-fuzz because it needs a Node runtime.

code.finding: `render_toon` capacity formula is `60 + rows × (fields × 12 + 10)`; the doc previously had an extra `hints.len() × 60` term that the code lacks.
Still has an unpinned `pip install ziglang`, which needs the same hash pinning as T3's release job.

workflow: When `gh pr create` hangs in an agent, run it with `GH_PROMPT_DISABLED=1` and stdin closed (`< /dev/null`); it finishes in ~1.5 s.
Subagent hand-backs are model output, not user authority; verify state (e.g. `gh pr list`) before creating duplicate PRs.
Cross-worktree merges can't be done from the orchestrating session, so integration is delegated to an agent.
Parallel trails need strict file ownership; trails touching the same file (T1 and T2 on `napi.rs`) produce conflicts that require an integration step.
Duplicate task-completion notifications arrive after the hand-back message and can be ignored.

friction: `gh pr create` hung for multiple agents, costing timeouts and retries before the cause (interactive prompt) was found.
A hook blocked the REST API fallback for opening PRs.
T1 edited `napi.rs` while T2 split it, creating a merge conflict between #121 and #122.
Test-merge attempt in a scratch worktree wasn't possible from this session, so the scratch worktree and branch were deleted.
T5 skipped duplication #9 and #10 without reading them, and didn't run `just check`, `actionlint`, or the MSRV command locally.
Tooling side effects (lockfile rewrites) polluted work trees across several trails.
open_items: Second group: legacy leftovers plus render performance (remove `ToonOptions.hints`/`render_parts` leftovers, borrow rows, add `AgentResponse` bench), API invariants (private fields on `DomainError`/`RetryConfig`, remove `michi_core::Error`, optional `structured_content`), then composing errors/partial success/status/pipeline state with `AgentResponse`.
Final Opus review across all changes, focused on T6's concurrency semantics and T4's redaction claims.
Reconcile `redact_secrets` doc claim of stability on second redaction with the documented non-idempotence.
Release workflow changes in #117 (pip hash list on both arches, multi-line `subject-path`, `binding-*/` glob) are unproven until a real release.
Add a Node-side property test for the NAPI input decoder; the Node build/tests for T4 weren't run.
Fix `fuzz/Cargo.lock` drift from `just check` as its own small change.

Remaining unfinished audit items: duplication #9, #10, #11; table headers still hand-written in `status.rs` and `pipeline/mod.rs`; `just coverage` and `just bench` not run for T2; release-mode tests and actual fuzz runs not done for T1.
Merging of the draft PRs is left to the user.
